evidence.reason: The configured maximum is returned by `_supported_completion_window` when `max_completion_window` is set, but only the derived `required` value is checked against it. An explicit `completion_timeout` is then checked only for being below `required`, so a timeout greater than the supported maximum passes both checks and is assigned to `_completion_window`. This makes the actual completion deadline exceed the configured cap. Rejecting `completion_timeout > supported` before assignment is the smallest compatible fix and preserves overrides between `required` and `supported`.
